leaguebot: Reminder: Waiver processing at 00:00 UTC. Good luck.

Noah: Bar on 3rd has value wings though.
Sam K: Office + wings from Maya? paying in snacks.

leaguebot: Poll created: "Playoff watch party location? Office kitchen / Bar on 3rd" Voting open 24h.
